summary: HomesToLife Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an internal change to how CFO Zhengjie Jeff Chai is engaged. The company terminated its May 1, 2026 services agreement with related-party HTL Furniture Inc., effective October 31, 2026, and entered a new services agreement with indirect wholly owned subsidiary HomesToLife Inc., effective November 1, 2026. Chai continues uninterrupted on substantially identical compensation. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or regulatory clock is stated; this is a routine administrative filing, not a special situation.
